name: Tavoro Waterfalls
bio_draft: Waterfalls (nature): three falls in Bouma park, the most accessible on Taveuni, 15 minutes to an hour's walk.

name: Lavena Coastal Walk
bio_draft: Walk (coastal track): about four hours return from Lavena village to a swimming hole and waterfalls, with a small fee.

name: Des Voeux Peak
bio_draft: Peak (mountain): Fiji's second-highest peak at 1,196 m, reached by hike or 4WD, with birdlife.

name: Rainbow Reef
bio_draft: Reef (dive area): patch reef in the Somosomo Strait between Taveuni and Vanua Levu, one of the South Pacific's best-known dive sites.

name: Waitabu Marine Park
bio_draft: Marine park (community reef): 1 km of fringing reef protected by seven communities, with snorkelling.

name: Lake Tagimaucia
bio_draft: Lake (crater lake): volcanic crater lake at about 800 m, habitat of the tagimaucia flower, reached by guided hike.
